# Ingest fixtures

FICTIONAL test data for the discovery/enrichment pipeline. These pages and API responses
imitate the *shape* of real-world sources (restaurant websites, Overpass, Overture,
Foursquare) so parsers can be tested offline. None of these businesses exist. They are
only ever loaded into the throwaway databases the test suite creates and drops; they are never
seeded into a real Supabase project or shown to users.
